title: CheaperGaps
description: This datapack makes crafting golden apples way easier.
body:
This Datapack replaces the  8 gold ingots you need to craft a golden apple with 8 gold nuggets. Easy to set up and use!

Remember: This is a Datapack, which means you cannot put it in your mods folder. This is how you install it:
navigate to .minecraft/saves/"world for your datapack"/datapacks

Now simply unarchive the .zip file and place the new folder in here!
